clips.title: The story
paras: This errand carries word of relief from the crags of Stonetalon back to the night elf outpost of Astranaar. Having aided Kaela Shadowspear and Gaxim Rustfizzle against the encroaching Venture Company, you are tasked with reassuring Sentinel Tara Thenysil that their outpost holds firm.

Stonetalon's jagged passes are an isolated and vulnerable frontier for the night elves. With goblin deforestation operations eating away at the crags and polluting the waterways, the outpost manned by Kaela Shadowspear and the gnome tinkerer Gaxim Rustfizzle operates under constant threat. Once the immediate dangers posed by the Venture Company are blunted, keeping the command hierarchy informed is essential. Kaela sends you northeast across the border back into Ashenvale to confirm their survival.

In the forested sanctuary of Astranaar, Sentinel Tara Thenysil maintains watch over Ashenvale's interior roads while worrying over scouts deployed into harsher territories. Receiving confirmation that both Kaela and her eccentric engineering partner are alive and actively healing the land offers a rare moment of good news. It proves that despite dwindling forces and multiple hostile fronts, cooperation with Alliance allies can stem the tide of ecological destruction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you have done a great deed by lending a hand here.
The Sentinels of Ashenvale will reward you well if you informed them that Gaxim and I are alive. Tell them we are well on our way to stopping the Venture Co. And healing the lands.
Find Tara Thenysil in Astranaar; she will be pleased to see you've returned with good news.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. You have done a service to the Sentinels.
I'm glad to see Kaela... And even Gaxim, are doing well.
